Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All masks are sanitizers.

All handwashes are sanitizers.

All sanitizers are medicines.

**Conclusions:**

I. All handwashes are medicines.

II. All medicines are masks.

III. Some medicines are handwashes.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb8ee64f702be74cb392a111912c3560c6411698c6a52769e103fb3df43e0774.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All handwashes are medicines → Follow (As, all handwashes are sanitizers and all sanitizers are medicines. So, all handwashes are definitely medicines)

II. All medicines are masks → Dos not Follow (As, all masks are sanitizers and all sanitizers are medicines. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

III. Some medicines are handwashes → Follow (As, all handwashes are sanitizers and all sanitizers are medicines. So, Some medicines are handwashes)

So, Only conclusions I and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusions I and III follow**".

questions.question: Which of the following is a metamorphic rock?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Quartzite.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Quarzite is a metamorphic rock formed from pure quartz sandstone.
 
• It is white to grey in color.
 
• Orthoquartzite is a very pure quartz sandstone composed of usually well-rounded quartz grains cemented by Silica.
 
• Orthoquartzite is often 99% SiO2 with only very minor amounts of iron oxide and trace-resistant minerals such as zircon, rutile, and magnetite.
 
• Quartzite is very resistant to chemical weathering and often forms ridges and resistant hilltop​rns.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
 

 Types of rocks
 Characteristics
 
 

 Igneous rock
 
 
 
• It is formed when molten rock (magma or lava) cools and solidifies.
 
• Igneous rock may form with or without crystallization.
 
• It may be intrusive (plutonic) rocks or extrusive (volcanic) rocks.
 
• For example, Granite, Basalt, etc.
 
 
 
 

 Sedimentary rock
 
 
 
• They originate when particles settle out of water or air, or by precipitation of minerals from water.
 
• They accumulate in layers.
 
• For example, Sandstone, Limestone, etc.
 
 
 
 

 Metamorphic rock
 
 
 
• They formed when existing rocks are changed by heat, pressure, or reactive fluids, such as hot, mineral-laden water.
 
• For example, Marble, Quartzite, Schist, etc.

questions.question: Which among the following Bihu is also known as Rongali Bihu?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Bohag Bihu__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Bohag Bihu, also known as the Rongali Bihu, is a joyous festival that marks the start of spring and the Assamese New Year.
 
• Assam celebrates Bihu, Baishagu, Ali-Ai-Ligang, Baikho, Rongker, and Rajini Gabra as its important holidays. Bohaggiyo Bishu, Jonbill Mela, Ambubashi Mela, and others include Harni Gabra.
 
• The most well-known Bihu, Bohag Bihu (mid-April; also known as Rongali Bihu), marks the beginning of the Assamese New Year (about 14–15 April) and the arrival of spring.

• To put it another way, it is the sum of assets that remain after all liabilities have been settled.
 
• Stockholder's equity and shareholder's equity are other names for a company's net worth.
 
• By deducting the subject company's total liabilities from its total assets, one can arrive at the formula for net worth.

• The net worth calculation takes into account both assets and liabilities.

• If net worth is more than zero, it can pay off debt and has strong financial growth.
 
• If net worth is zero, the company cannot pay its debts and has negative financial growth.

questions.question: A, B and C run at speeds 5 m/s, 3 m/s and 8 m/s respectively. They start the race at the same time from the same point. After some time, it was found that the distance between A and C is 6 m. Determine the distance between A and B.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of A = 5 m/s

Speed of B = 3 m/s

Speed of C = 8 m/s

Distance between A and C = 6 m

**Concept:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Solution:**

The relative speed of A and C is 8 - 5 = 3 m/s.

Given the distance of 6 m between A and C, they've been running for 6/3 = 2 seconds.

In 2 seconds, B runs 3 m/s × 2 s = 6 m, and A runs 5 m/s × 2 s = 10 m.

The distance between A and B is 10 m - 6 m = 4 m.

**Hence, the distance between A and B is 4 m.**

questions.question: Balvendra offers two successive discounts of 9% and 4% first and then he also provides a cash discount of Rs.268 on the sale of a CCTV camera. If the marked price of the CCTV camera is Rs.5,000, what is the final price of the CCTV camera for a customer?

Calculate successive discounts using direct multiplying factors for efficiency:

Subtracting the final cash discount of Rs.268:

Successive Discounts

When multiple discounts are given sequentially on the continuously reduced value, they are known as successive discounts. The equivalent single discount percentage for two successive discounts d₁ and d₂ is (d₁ + d₂ − d₁×d₂/100)%.

Marked Price vs Selling Price

A discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP). The amount the customer finally pays is the Selling Price (SP), given by SP = MP − Discount Amount.

Cash Discount

A cash discount is an outright fixed monetary reduction subtracted directly from the total bill, unlike percentage discounts which scale proportionately with the base amount.
